name: generated-app
//: Frontend + full-stack-preview deps are pre-installed (baked into the committed package-lock.json + the pre-built preview image) so the preview renders AND a generated Hono backend runs WITHOUT an on-the-fly install. The backend stack — hono, @hono/node-server, drizzle-orm, @electric-sql/pglite (in-VM Postgres-in-WASM fallback), postgres (postgres-js, the real-Neon driver), dotenv, tsx, zod, @hono/zod-validator — is light (postgres-js is a single small pure-JS package). server/db/index.ts picks the driver at boot: postgres-js over the project's real Neon DATABASE_URL when AIWA injected one (.env), else PGlite. Same pg-core schema + routes either way.
